description:
£140 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious three-bedroom student property, occupying the entire top floor of a building on the ever-popular Osborne Road in Jesmond.

The property comprises a welcoming entrance, a large open-plan living, dining and kitchen area, three generously sized double bedrooms, including one with an en-suite, and a modern main bathroom.

Situated in the heart of Jesmond, the property is ideally located for easy access to a fantastic range of local amenities, including popular bars, restaurants, cafés and shops, making it an excellent choice for student living.
